reviewer.independence: read-only repository audit; no source or release mutation
reviewer.conflict_declaration: No financial, patient, commercial, or release-authority conflict declared; this is a technical scope receipt only.

review_target.scope: candidate research-only release: code, methodology, documentation, synthetic fixtures, candidate-only derived evidence, and validation artifacts

checks.evidence: Tracked files contain no raw restricted source payloads, identifiable patient data, confidential price tables, or undisclosed commercial agreements; source-derived material is represented by candidate/derived metadata and negative receipts.
No tracked environment files, private keys, certificates, credential files, API keys, passwords, or access tokens were found in the release inventory.

Release notes and readiness artifacts explicitly set approved_calibration_permitted=false, keep Scenario 1 candidate_only and Scenarios 2-4 not_identifiable, and exclude calibrated reimbursement, HTA, policy, and regulator-facing claims.

Atlas, Kairos, and other upstream terms remain separately adjudicated gates. Unresolved or source-restricted material must be excluded from the public artifact; this receipt does not grant redistribution or extraction authorization.

The repository owner authorization covers research software and methodology only. A final release freeze must recompute artifact hashes and confirm destination-specific licence/source-term dispositions.

excluded_from_release: credentials, secrets, and private access material
unreviewed model output presented as evidence
Atlas/Kairos artifacts lacking explicit source-term and extraction authorization
conditions: Recompute the release boundary hash and all artifact hashes at final tag freeze.
Exclude any artifact whose licence, extraction, or destination terms remain unresolved.
Retain the research-only claim restrictions in release notes and package metadata.
Do not treat this technical receipt as legal, payer, regulator, Atlas, or Kairos maintainer approval.
limitations: This audit is repository-local and cannot verify undisclosed external material.
A changed commit, packet, dependency revision, or release destination supersedes this receipt.
Final publication still requires the owner release authorization and hosted qualification evidence.

attestation.statement: I audited the frozen repository scope for restricted data, credentials, privacy exposure, and prohibited claims without modifying implementation files.
